name: Espirito Santo
title: LGBT rights in Espirito Santo
extract: Lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and queer (LGBTQ) people in the Brazilian state of Espírito Santo enjoy many of the protections available to non-LGBTQ people. Despite this, according to data from the Agência Diadorim, the number of anti-LGBTQ bills has been growing in the state.
